name: Publix Grocery Distribution Center Jacksonville FL

fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled gated entry on the internal access road just south of the at-grade rail crossing; z20-z21 satellite shows a canopy/checkpoint spanning the lanes with a semi and cars stopped at the control point, plus directional lane arrows. Driveway approach from the road is long and deep.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Distinctive zigzag-roofed security/admin building sits immediately beside the gate lanes on the inbound side; vehicles queue at the checkpoint canopy beside it. Staffed manned entry.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single gate complex on the north access road; inbound (up-arrow) and outbound (down-arrow) lanes are split within the same checkpoint footprint, so entry/exit are co-located, not at separate property points.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound lanes at the checkpoint from arrow markings; medium confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane gate apron with unused paved width and an undivided approach; room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band easily met across the campus: the west building has a very long continuous dock bank (east face) with 30+ trailers backed in plus a south-face bank; the east building has a full south-face dock bank. Total estimated ~140 doors.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+; extensive striped trailer drop rows north/east of the docks and along the yard with well over 100 parked trailers visible.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two separate large DC buildings (perishable + grocery) with dock banks on different faces and a third maintenance/repair structure; ship and receive run from physically distinct dock clusters.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus with at least two large DC buildings plus a zigzag admin/security building and a SW maintenance/trailer-shop building.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail line/spur runs along the north edge of the property with an at-grade crossing on the entrance road; corroborated by directory listing (rail-and-highway accessible).
fieldNotes.scale: No clearly identifiable truck scale pad in the gate path from overhead imagery; left false but flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Counted 3 principal structures: west DC, east DC, and the SW maintenance building (zigzag admin building not counted as a DC).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 32.3 ac from the traced fenced operational footprint; the broader parcel including grass/tree buffers to W Beaver St is larger.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: West Jacksonville metro fabric: subdivisions immediately north and south across W Beaver St, a major divided arterial frontage. Urban.
